description: Adds one candidate to the recruiting board, as New candidate does: full_name is required; phone, email, source (indeed, meta, referral, website, inbox, other), source_external_id, hiring_round, track (cleaner or card_marketer), salary_expectation, notes, next_action, next_action_at, resume_url, indeed_url and client_id are optional. Deduped on source_external_id, then email, then phone: re-adding someone already on the board returns them untouched (created false). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: create_candidate
title: Add a recruiting candidate
